messages:
Alex K: Heads up — since 03:00 UTC AZ-a got a weird provision surge. Lots of small GPU pods landed and now many racks have scattered 0.25/0.5 slots.
Marie T: Seeing the same. Pod pending count jumped ~120 in AZ-a. Node CPU is fine but GPU slot usage is super fragmented.
Sanjay R: Any recent autoscaler or instance template changes? Could be a rollout.
Alex K: No infra rollout. I traced it to a batch of model inference jobs that changed resource requests — moved from 1xA100 to fractional requests.
Jen L: Oof. Scheduler is struggling to coalesce. We're getting repeated preemptions: 'Insufficient GPU' followed by tiny placements.
ops-oncall: tagging infra team, are we hitting any NIC egress throttles that could cause slow kubelet heartbeats? :eyes:
infra-bot: Alert: AZ-a provisioning spike — 84 new GPU pods scheduled in last 15m. Avg schedule latency 12s (baseline 3s).
Marie T: Two problems: (1) binpacking fragmentation from fractional GPU requests, (2) warm pool too small to absorb shard density. Cost risk if we scale up more nodes.
Sanjay R: Can we snapshot offending pods? Query:
```
kubectl get pods -n prod -o wide --field-selector=status.phase=Pending | grep gpu
```
Alex K: I grabbed a sample and posted in the doc: many pods request 0.25/0.5 GPU with anti-affinity to 'gpu-intensive' label. That's blocking co-location.
Jen L: Suggestion: short term -- relax the anti-affinity for that job class (canary) and increase warm-pool count in AZ-a to reduce schedule churn.
Marie T: Also we should enable fractional packing plugin (experimental) on the scheduler for this cluster — it coalesces fractional allocations into a gang on same node.
Sanjay R: Risk: fractional packing increases interference on NVLink; need to gate by instance type. Let's throttle for non-NVLink racks.
ops-oncall: I can patch a quick config to relax topologySpread for that deployment. Anyone object to a 30m change window?
Alex K: Do it. Also create a rollback playbook if eviction churn spikes.
Jen L: Rolling change snippet:
```
kubectl patch deploy batch-infer -n prod -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"affinity":null}}}}'
```
Marie T: I'll open a short-lived autoscaler policy to prefer binpack on GPU hours and limit surge nodes.
infra-bot: Incident note attached to thread: INVESTIGATING - AZ-a fractional allocation/packing
Sanjay R: Post-mortem action items: (1) audit jobs emitting fractional GPUs, (2) scheduler feature flag for fractional-coalesce, (3) warmpool sizing automation by rack.
Alex K: Thanks team — applying patches now. I'll update once schedule latency drops. :thumbsup:
